Moreover, there is evidence that the relevance of the post-workout window of opportunity is dependent on the timing of the pre-workout meal. In a proof-of-principle study, my lab randomized resistance-trained men to consume a supplement containing 25 g of protein either immediately before performance of total-body resistance exercise or immediately after the workout (125). After 10 weeks, both groups experienced similar changes in fat-free mass and muscle thickness measures regardless of the timing of protein consumption.
